standard: Core Web Vitals and project performance budgets

coverage.checklistItem: Choose the pages, workflows, devices, networks, locations, and user states to test.
coverage.note: The runner records one public URL and one desktop condition; representative scope requires project and audience context.

coverage.checklistItem: Record the release, test setup, performance budgets, and most important user outcomes.
coverage.note: The package records the URL, browser, profile, timestamps, and desktop form factor; the reviewer supplies release, budgets, and user outcomes.

coverage.checklistItem: Use production data from real users when it is available and reliable.
coverage.note: The local runner does not retrieve analytics, real-user monitoring, or Chrome UX Report data.

coverage.checklistItem: Review LCP, INP, and CLS for mobile and desktop and note when real-user data is insufficient.
coverage.note: Lighthouse supplies one desktop lab LCP and CLS sample plus TBT as an INP diagnostic; field INP and mobile and desktop percentiles remain manual.

coverage.checklistItem: Run repeatable tests against a production build and compare them with the current baseline.
coverage.note: The runner fixes its desktop procedure and records the result; the reviewer confirms the build and compares equivalent runs with an approved baseline.

coverage.checklistItem: Test both warm and cold cache behavior when it matters.
coverage.note: The profile provides one isolated Lighthouse navigation; a separate controlled test is required for meaningful warm and cold comparisons.

coverage.checklistItem: Check server response time, redirects, caching, compression, and CDN behavior.
coverage.note: Lighthouse samples the reviewed navigation and selected delivery opportunities; CDN configuration and representative regional behavior require additional evidence.

coverage.checklistItem: Resize and encode images for how they are displayed.
coverage.note: Lighthouse flags image delivery opportunities on the reviewed page; source variants, CMS behavior, breakpoints, and other templates still require review.

coverage.checklistItem: Load the main page content and LCP resource promptly.
coverage.note: The profile records lab LCP and Lighthouse diagnostics for one page; field behavior and the correctness of the chosen LCP content require review.

coverage.checklistItem: Remove or delay code and assets that block rendering or are not needed.
coverage.note: Lighthouse identifies likely render-blocking and unused resources; source ownership, route coverage, and safe removal require analysis.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm personalized or private responses are not cached publicly.
coverage.note: This requires source, CDN, cache-key, response-header, and authenticated-state evidence that a public single-page run cannot establish.

coverage.checklistItem: Test important interactions, find long tasks, and give users prompt feedback.
coverage.note: Lighthouse records page-load blocking and long-task diagnostics; important interactions and user feedback require representative interaction testing.

coverage.checklistItem: Prevent unexpected layout shifts and keep animations efficient.
coverage.note: The profile checks initial-load CLS and Lighthouse diagnostics; shifts and animations after interaction or during long-lived sessions remain manual.

coverage.checklistItem: Inventory analytics, tag managers, chat, video, maps, ads, and other third-party code.
coverage.note: Lighthouse reports observed third-party impact on one page; the reviewer completes the inventory across routes, states, consent choices, and integrations.

coverage.checklistItem: Remove unused third parties and test important dependencies when they are slow or unavailable.
coverage.note: The profile identifies likely cost but does not disable dependencies or simulate their slow and failed states.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm performance problems do not create unusable pages or endless retries.
coverage.note: The runner records whether the sampled page loaded and whether browser errors occurred; degraded networks, retry behavior, and important workflows require controlled testing.

coverage.checklistItem: Investigate meaningful regressions rather than treating every score change as a failure.
coverage.note: The package supplies one controlled result; equivalent baselines, run variance, user impact, and regression judgment remain human responsibilities.

coverage.checklistItem: Retest fixes, note important tradeoffs, and assign an owner for monitoring production performance.
coverage.note: Retesting requires a changed release, and tradeoffs and production ownership require project decisions.
